title: Resteasy builtin providers being pulled in for more ITs than expected
body:
**Describe the bug**
The following set of ITs seems to be pulling in the resteasy builtin providers (including `org.jboss.resteasy.plugins.providers.IIOImageProvider`) resulting in the native image to depend on graph libraries (like `lcms`, `libawt` etc.)

```
quarkus-integration-test-bouncycastle-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-bouncycastle-fips-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-bouncycastle-jsse-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-infinispan-client-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-main-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-kafka-avro-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-hibernate-orm-panache-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-hibernate-orm-panache-kotlin-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-hibernate-search-orm-elasticsearch-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-vertx-http-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-vertx-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-spring-di-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-spring-web-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-spring-boot-properties-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-spring-cloud-config-client-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-elytron-resteasy-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-elytron-undertow-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-liquibase-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-oidc-client-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-oidc-token-propagation-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-reactive-db2-client-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-reactive-pg-client-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-reactive-mysql-client-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-amazon-services-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-amazon-lambda-http-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-amazon-lambda-http-resteasy-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-tika-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-jsch-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-artemis-core-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-artemis-jms-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-narayana-stm-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-elytron-security-jdbc-integration-test-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-elytron-security-ldap-integration-test-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-redis-client-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-logging-gelf-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-bootstrap-config-application-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-reactive-messaging-http-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-rest-client-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-consul-config-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-grpc-tls-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-grpc-plain-text-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-grpc-plain-text-mutiny-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-grpc-mutual-auth-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-grpc-interceptors-1.11.0.Final-runner
quarkus-integration-test-grpc-proto-v2-1.11.0.Final-runner
```

**Expected behavior**
Most (if not all) of these tests shouldn't depend on graph libraries.

**Actual behavior**
The tests depend on graph libraries.

**To Reproduce**

Fast, but not exactly a reproducer:
```
wget https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/archive/1.11.0.Final.tar.gz
tar xf 1.11.0.Final.tar.gz
cd quarkus-1.11.0.Final
# Set a breakpoint at
# https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/c1014913542bbe81a4340b8388fa36a501e1b833/extensions/resteasy-common/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/resteasy/common/deployment/ResteasyCommonProcessor.java#L228
./mvnDebug clean verify -pl integration-tests/bouncycastle
# Attach debugger and run, if the breakpoint is hit and the value of `useBuiltinProviders` is `true`
# then all providers in `availableProviders` get pulled in
```

Slow, but the actual reproducer:
```
wget https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/archive/1.11.0.Final.tar.gz
tar xf 1.11.0.Final.tar.gz
cd quarkus-1.11.0.Final
./mvnw clean verify \
    -Dnative -Dquarkus.native.additional-build-args="-H:+TraceNativeToolUsage" \
    -pl integration-tests/bouncycastle
# look for `liblcms.a` in the linker command
```
